title: Transparent delegation contract and integration coverage
description: Activate/update cross-runtime behavioral coverage for questions, malformed output, tap-outs, launch failures, recovery, fencing, cancellation, and scripted/real Codex integration.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Complete. Cross-runtime coverage now exists for each listed behavior, all as shared Gherkin run by behave and cucumber with the spec-parity check in CI: questions and blocked outcomes and reply resume (router_agent_resume.feature, router_recovery_and_publication.feature); malformed and undefined-outcome results preserved for review (router_codex_adapter.feature); tap-outs and retryable failures with bounded backoff and Blocked after three (router_recovery_and_publication.feature); fencing, where an obsolete claim cannot publish a checkpoint, artifact or result (router_recovery_and_publication.feature, router_multi_router_coordination.feature); cancellation (router_execution_and_controls.feature); and launch failures, added in PR #365: an agent command that cannot be started leaves a Kanbus Issue Router comment and moves the package to blocked. Scripted integration is the containerized harness (kbs-2730cc) run live with a fake agent, and real Codex runs were exercised earlier on live board issues.
